target: Add a Dopemux-owned PCP PROJECT extension for AdOps using explicit source-backed authority, packet, proof, audit, candidate, and readiness mappings without modifying AdOps.
invariants: Risk lane is L2 because repository authority semantics are mapped into a planner projection.
TP-DMX-PCP-PLANNER-FOUNDATION-001 must be accepted and its interfaces frozen before activation.
DDD-Enterprises/adOps is read-only under this packet.
Do not copy, vendor, or port dNh tools/gov into AdOps or Dopemux.
The extension cannot override PCP fail-closed, proof, audit, or non-authority invariants.
Local-only commits and Downloads or temporary-worktree artifacts cannot become published candidates.

execution.stacked_because: Consumes the accepted foundation adapter protocol; never stacks on an unaccepted implementation head.

pr.title: feat(pcp): add read-only AdOps extension
pr.body: Adds a source-backed AdOps PROJECT extension to the accepted PCP planner contract. AdOps remains read-only; no dNh governance code is copied. L2 final independent audit required.

steps.task: Freeze the AdOps source inventory at commit 864915b9cc8ff254eaa877627df1e510dc49dbec and record every imported byte.
requirements: Read PROJECT_INSTRUCTIONS.md, applicable overlays, task packet pointers, selected proof and audit records, and Git identity only from explicit allowlisted paths.
Create SOURCES.json with GitHub blob URLs, blob SHAs, SHA-256, fetched_at, privacy class, and redaction notes.
Represent PR #277 as design evidence, not implementation acceptance.
Represent legacy commit 4ce6b644afa72231c24b3cdac58f251e1ca03321 as REMOTE_COMMIT_ABSENT unless a named remote ref independently proves otherwise.
validation: All fixture bytes resolve to the pinned Git commit or are marked operator-supplied with a hash.
No local absolute path, secret, raw conversation, or inferred acceptance appears.

steps.task: Declare and validate the additive AdOps extension manifest and authority mappings.
requirements: Use extension_kind PROJECT and status PROPOSED until Control Tower activation.
Map PROJECT_INSTRUCTIONS.md before Copilot and optional agent overlays.
Map active packet, proof roots, audit records, acceptance records, remote candidate identity, and AdOps red lanes without defining new authority.
Set all five PCP extension invariants to true.
validation: Manifest validates against the accepted PCP extension schema.
No mapping promotes GitHub, Task Orchestrator, planner, or conversation context to terminal authority.

steps.task: Implement and register the AdOps adapter against the frozen foundation protocol.
requirements: Implement AdOpsExtensionAdapter.enrich(generic_export: Mapping[str, object], source_root: Path) -> SourceSnapshot.
The adapter reads verified bytes only and does not fetch, repair, mutate, or infer readiness from absence.
Unknown proof layout, missing packet, stale audit, failed audit, source conflict, and absent remote candidate fail closed.
validation: Generic PCP exports for non-AdOps repositories are byte-equivalent before and after registration.
Malformed AdOps data is isolated to AdOps and does not erase other portfolio projects.
No dNh tools/gov file is added or modified.

steps.task: Freeze the exact content head and complete one independent L2 audit.
requirements: Audit authority precedence, provenance, fail-closed mappings, generic PCP non-regression, and source-repository inertness.
Any head mismatch or non-passing audit blocks readiness.
validation: Proof binds the exact head and confirms DDD-Enterprises/adOps was not mutated.
PR remains unmerged pending Control Tower disposition.
